title: kv-fragmentation-gradient-and-proactive-reserve-controller
author: Diego Morales
description: Motivation: We observed sustained KV cache fragmentation under mixed chat+embed workloads which causes frequent small-page spillovers and I/O amplification during tail-loads. This PR introduces a new fragmentation gradient metric and an adjacent proactive layered reservation controller to reduce fragmentation-induced paging. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce 'fragmentation gradient' telemetry that measures per-shard contiguous free-run distribution and short-term slope to predict imminent fragmentation events. 2) Add a proactive reserve controller that maintains a small pool of contiguous reservation slices in a layered fashion (hot, warm, cold) and replenishes them during low-utilization windows. The controller integrates with eviction and the scheduler so reservations are pre-emptively allocated on nodes that will receive bursty workloads. 3) Modify the KV allocator to prefer adjacent-slot allocation when gradient predicts increasing fragmentation; fall back to best-fit otherwise. 4) Hook controller signals into the continuous-batching scheduler to avoid batching across boundaries that would force extra KV copying. 5) New metrics/endpoints and retrofit to the Console: fragmentation_gradient, reserve_pool_utilization, reserve_replenish_events. Why this matters: experiments on canary clusters show a 18% reduction in spill I/O bytes and a 12% improvement in p95 latency for tokenize-heavy chat traces (90th-99th percentile heavy tails). Implementation notes and compatibility: changes are opt-in via config flags (kv.fragmentation_gradient.enabled, kv.reserve_controller.mode=proactive|passive) and default to off for Dedicated until we validate at scale. No API changes to external users. Rollout plan: enable in benchmark-lab and perf-canary for 2 weeks, monitor fragmentation_gradient and spillback metrics, then staggered enablement on Dedicated min groups. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (ENG-3145) - [x] unit tests for allocator heuristics - [x] integration tests with continuous batching toggled - [x] bench runs and flame graphs attached - [x] Console metrics wired - [x] feature-flag gating - [x] docs/notes in runbooks (for SRE) See also related work: this PR complements the KV-prefetch work (ENG-2971) and interacts with spillback-rate limiting (ENG-3210).
